description: Give leagues (such as nba, nfl, premier league, ufc) and a date or date range. Returns one row per game with teams, home and away, status, score, period scores, winner, start time, and venue. Filter by team or status. Refused reads and summary rows are free. Pay per event on Apify.

date_from.description: First schedule day as YYYY-MM-DD, or today, yesterday, or tomorrow. ESPN files games by US Eastern time.

date_to.description: Last schedule day. Empty means the same as date from. A run reads at most 62 days and 400 league days.

leagues.description: ESPN league paths such as basketball/nba or soccer/eng.1, or names such as nfl, premier league, champions league, college football, ufc. Empty means NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, and the Premier League. Tennis is not read here.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_games.description: Stop after this many game rows. Default 500.

statuses.description: scheduled, live, final, postponed, canceled, suspended, delayed, other, or the shortcuts finished and upcoming. Empty means all.

teams.description: Keep games where a team or fighter name or abbreviation holds one of these words, such as celtics or BOS.

name: get_sports_scores_fixtures
title: Get sports scores and fixtures
